title: FBS Namespace Claim v1.0.0
description: A signed assertion that an actor holding the namespace:claim capability has issuing or controlling authority over a barcode value range or namespace. Defined in RFC FBS0001 Section 4.2.3.

id.description: Stable HTTPS URL at which this claim can be retrieved

claimedBy.description: Actor Identifier of the actor asserting this claim. MUST hold namespace:claim capability.

namespaceType.description: Namespace type: 'gs1' for GS1-track claims, 'self' for self-sovereign namespace claims

scope.description: Scope of the claimed authority. Structure depends on namespaceType. For gs1: {symbologies, prefixes}. For self: {fni}

issuedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this claim was created in ISO 8601 format

expiresAt.description: UTC timestamp after which the claim is no longer valid. REQUIRED for gs1 claims, OPTIONAL for self claims.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the claim. Structure depends on namespaceType. See RFC FBS0001 Section 4.2.3.3 for details.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over canonical form of claim. For gs1 claims: signed by actor's primary keypair. For self claims: signed by namespace keypair.
